question: In a certain language, CHHAPAK is coded as DJKEUGR. How will MALANGA be coded in that language?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png]

CHHAPAK is coded as DJKEUGR.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/42f4e15dd1aab68b3b859b18590e5157315e2aefa8fd336c33d10913403da999.png]
